caption:
SEBI PLANS CONSULTATION PAPER TO EASE FPI RULES

SEBI announced it will release a consultation paper that seeks to remove certain compliance restrictions for foreign portfolio investors.
The changes include speeding onboarding to five business days and extending KYC review cycles, which should make India more attractive to global investors and lower repetitive compliance work.

For information only. Not investment advice.
